limitations.note: The patch fixed the counter advancing without an accepted bit, but also changed reset and first-edge acceptance by hardwiring `ready_a` high, and changed `valid_b` during stalls at count five by gating it with `valid_a`.

The test exercised stalls and reset, but its scoreboard assumed `ready_a` was always high and `valid_b` only pulsed on the sixth accepted bit, so it endorsed the extra changes instead of detecting them.
The same testbench had to be submitted three times because the first wrapper used a rejected `rm -f` cleanup command and the second invoked an unavailable `python` executable.
